comparison.objective: Candidate removes HELICOIL tangs; record uses a compass away from steel interference to orient a telescope mount north.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires force-controlled hammering and fragment recovery; record requires relocating a sensing instrument, interpreting its heading, and rotating a large mount.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures, undamaged inserts, and recovered fragments; record requires the N leg oriented north based on an uncompromised compass reading, though no angular tolerance is provided.
comparison.reason: Sensor-interference reasoning and global orientation are unrelated to localized impact fracture.
